source.spreadsheet_title: Question and Suggested answer data Bank

rows.hard_stop_condition: Wrong repository, unsafe dirty-worktree conflict, or unknown production target

rows.required_evidence: Auth, database, AI model, Sheets, email, PDF, analytics, routes, deployment map
rows.hard_stop_condition: Existing features or Website Upload contract would break

rows.required_evidence: Exact 50/100/30/60 counts, distributions, unique IDs, required fields, HTTPS links, Gaerlan evidence
rows.hard_stop_condition: Count mismatch, duplicate, broken required source, or unsupported authorship
rows.beta_rule: Human approval waived for current beta only

rows.required_evidence: Beta warnings and post-beta draft/review/approve/publish flag tests
rows.hard_stop_condition: Unapproved content can publish when human-review flag is enabled
rows.beta_rule: Current beta auto-publication allowed after automated checks

rows.required_evidence: Role matrix, ownership, beta access, future premium flag, admin preservation
All explicit limits plus canary searches across DB/logs/analytics/traces
rows.hard_stop_condition: Silent truncation or raw Bar Easy/doctrine text persists anywhere

rows.required_evidence: Golden whole/selected PDFs, ownership, notices, watermark, Unicode, 25 MB behavior
rows.hard_stop_condition: Missing mandatory block/notice, unauthorized export, or corrupt output
rows.beta_rule: Export open to beta through flag

rows.required_evidence: Structured schemas, enums, calibration, injection, malformed/timeout tests
rows.hard_stop_condition: Unvalidated output, unfair label behavior, or prompt injection succeeds

rows.required_evidence: Non-roster denial, duplicate constraints, one attempt, dynamic exams with 1/7/20/35 questions, plus disclosed admin-configurable operational-ceiling tests if the infrastructure requires one
rows.hard_stop_condition: Code-only entry, duplicate enrollment/attempt, or hidden assumption of 20

rows.required_evidence: Hash/scope/rate limits, release revocation, old-key denial, sealed data, audited temporary dispute
rows.hard_stop_condition: Any old key works after release or admin dispute is unaudited

rows.required_evidence: Server deadline/hard close, autosave, auto-submit, incident/lock/unlock, right-click/copy/paste/fullscreen tests
rows.hard_stop_condition: Client controls deadline, data loss, self-unlock, or misleading anti-cheat claim

rows.required_evidence: Per-exam isolation, RAW writes, formula defense, outbox/idempotency/retry/reconcile/outage tests
rows.hard_stop_condition: Google blocks exam, cross-professor exposure, formula execution, or duplicate/conflicting backup

rows.required_evidence: Website grading, one summary, batch release, optional questionnaire, sealing and retry tests
rows.hard_stop_condition: Email flood, premature disclosure, or release does not revoke keys

rows.required_evidence: Migrations, constraints, indexes, transactions/RLS, role matrix, advisor review
rows.hard_stop_condition: Cross-tenant access, missing unique constraints, or unresolved high-severity warning

rows.required_evidence: Unit/integration/e2e, responsive, keyboard, contrast, uploads, XSS/CSRF, rate, performance, regression
rows.hard_stop_condition: Critical/high defect or inaccessible core workflow

rows.required_evidence: Production-like staging, backups, migration/rollback rehearsal, flags, integrations, alerts
rows.hard_stop_condition: Unverified migration, missing rollback/monitoring, or failed staging smoke

rows.required_evidence: G0-G15 PASS, target recheck, deploy/import, production smoke and monitoring
rows.hard_stop_condition: Any earlier gate not PASS or production smoke fails
rows.beta_rule: This prompt authorizes publish only after every gate passes
